personal.name: Shivani
personal.tagline: software developer with a product brain
personal.headline: I design, build, and ship.
personal.intro: I turn ideas into complete products — interfaces, APIs, and everything in between.
personal.description: I build end to end react/next js on the surface, Node and Python underneath, and the data model holding it together. Two years of shipping real products taught me the job doesn't stop at the component boundary: why the API takes 800ms, how auth scales, what the user feels between click and render.
personal.bio: I reach for Next.js and Express by default, open Figma when I need to think out loud, and reach for Python when the problem needs FastAPI or logic that shouldn't live in the browser. I obsess over the details most people ship past: the 200ms that feels slow, the schema that won't bend at scale, the motion that either earns its place or gets cut.

projects.name: feat: CodeCollab
projects.excerpt: Real-time collaborative coding platform. One shared editor, live cursors, zero context switching.
projects.description: CodeCollab lets developers code together in real time with live cursors, line locking, voice, chat, and GitHub integration in one screen. Built with Next.js 15, Monaco Editor, and Supabase Realtime for presence sync. Redux Toolkit manages shared session state across all panels simultaneously.
highlights: Sub-100ms cursor sync with line locking across unlimited collaborators
GitHub push, pull, and diff built into the editor, no tab switching
Voice, chat, and code in one screen, no external tools needed

projects.name: feat: CodeClash
projects.excerpt: 1v1 coding battles and contest management. Built for competitive programmers.
projects.description: Competitive programming platform with public and private contests in ACM-ICPC and Codeforces-style formats. React and TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js on the backend with PostgreSQL schemas, JWT auth, and Redis Pub/Sub plus BullMQ for scalable code execution across Python, JavaScript, Java, and C++. Real-time leaderboards via WebSocket updates.
highlights: Real-time leaderboards via WebSocket with Redis Pub/Sub and BullMQ job queues
Auto-evaluated submissions across Python, JavaScript, Java, and C++ at scale
PostgreSQL schemas, JWT auth, and Docker deployment on AWS

projects.name: feat: Chess Platform
projects.excerpt: Real-time chess with multiplayer and AI. One click to match, no account needed.
projects.description: Multiplayer chess where guests and logged-in users both get into a match in under 30 seconds. Solo players practice against Stockfish AI across three difficulty tiers. Built with Next.js, Socket.io for move sync, and Node.js with MongoDB for game state and player stats.
highlights: Server-side clock sync accurate to 50ms, zero client-side drift
No sign-up wall, guests play immediately with just a name
Full gameplay on screens under 400px, built mobile-first throughout

projects.name: feat: Classence
projects.excerpt: Online classroom platform. One account, two roles, switched by a single toggle.
projects.description: Classence lets the same person teach and learn from one account without separate logins. Teachers manage classes, live sessions, announcements, and assignments. Students join and submit from the same dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, MongoDB, and WebRTC for live classes without any third-party dependency.
highlights: Single account for both roles, onboarding friction cut in half
WebRTC built in directly, live class setup reduced from 4 steps to 1
Unified dashboard reduced screens per teacher session by 60%
